decision: 32 separable source regions can be selected from existing candidates without new art. Do not approve or integrate the mixed animation yet.

browser.note: 64px right/left and 48px right previews. Browser pixels differ for all 32 selected regions; this is not semantic pose, quality, natural gameplay, or FPS approval.

observations: At a fixed source-pixel scale, v2 idle last frame and v1 attack first frame have 192 versus 171 visible source-pixel heights (63.668 versus 56.705 at the 64px reference). This is a transition risk, not a stand-alone proof of failure.
The enlarged transition preview shows changes in body stance, chest-armour contour, sash placement and blade silhouette between the two drafts. No per-frame stretching was used to hide those changes.
The diagnostic bottom-center bbox anchor does not validate planted feet, body root stability or retained death anchors.
Original whole-sheet v1/v2 REVIEW results remain valid; this audit selects sound regions and does not repair or approve either full sheet.

nextStep: Evaluate cross-page visual continuity and authored ground pivots using these existing sources before considering a dedicated Vanguard identity/multi-page runtime contract. Do not bind by elite+tiger alone; do not reuse ordinary tiger or final-Boss identities. No third generation is justified by missing region count alone.
